set.body: Forward-review P1 against ADR 0001 D4b. align/cost.scala:242-295 reduces segment charts as coverage * bestMember + missingFraction * 0.5, while source.scala:172-188 reports only chart presence, not provider-observed coverage. Executable repro: a two-leaf segment with one exact chart and one missing returns d_chart=0.25; adding a role-reversed chart (pair distance 0.4) makes the segment score improve to 0.0 because best remains 0 and coverage becomes 1. A structural provider that abstains on the second fully charted leaf also returns 0.0 with reported coverage 2/2. This conflates match, chart coverage, and provider coverage and retains no winning-member receipt. Acceptance: declare the segment estimand/reducer independently of missingness; expose chart coverage and provider-observed coverage separately; retain member ids/per-member estimates or a reducer receipt; laws for added incompatible evidence, provider abstention, permutation, leaf equivalence, and Missing rather than neutral imputation. JVM/JS/Native.
set.title: P1 align estimand: separate segment structural match from missing/provider coverage
